title: E'line PM Runbook
subtitle: Eversys E'line (older generation) | E'2, E'4 and E'6 | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: Based on the E'line PM Kits Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700105849, 01.05.2026) for the brew and milk modules, and the Enigma | Shotmaster | E'choco PM Kits Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700111715) for every other module, as the E'line manual directs. Plus TI-240 and the e'Support history of service kit releases V3.0 (12.10.2026).

banners.text: E'line is the older generation. Brew and milk use E'line kits; every other module uses the Enigma kits (E'line PM manual p.4).
Updated October 2026: E'line brew kit EV102821 is no longer available; use EV118340 (it includes the top and bottom pistons). 24-month kits are now 36-month kits (TI-240).

E'line milk machines: the Enigma milk add-ons (EV108354 #3/#4, EV108312) are listed because the E'line manual sends every non-brew, non-milk module to the Enigma kits. Confirm the 1.5-Step frame kits with the Webshop configurator; they are not listed here.
12-month PM: only 12-month kits are listed. Hydraulic kits and the Everfoam, milk and hot water add-ons are 36-month items.

kits.name: E'line brew unit Standard (blue seal)
kits.note: One per brew unit. Replaces EV102821 (no longer available). Includes top piston 116915 and bottom piston 117268.

kits.name: Hydraulic add-on, E'choco
kits.note: NetSuite name: Kit - Solenoid Valve 25mm - ODE (same kit).

kits.name: E'line milk module V1 Standard
kits.note: E'line milk V1 kit. The manual lists no 36-month milk kit for E'line.

kits.name: E'choco Standard
kits.note: O-ring 118259 x2 (Ø6.07x1.78) in the V4.0 kit.

items.text: Check ground-coffee total: change burrs after every 2000 kg.
Clean the grinder at every service.
Clean, then apply a thin layer of grease (JAX Pyro-plate FGN) to the threads of the upper burr support.
Fit kit EV118340 on each brew unit.
Clean, then grease the shafts of the bottom arm and the top piston with JAX Pyro-plate FGN.
Grease the cylindrical pin on the shaft of the bottom arm with MOLYKOTE BR2 PLUS (Art. 150058).
Check the piston screens for clogging. Clean or replace if needed.
Fit EV109586 on each hydraulic module.
Fit EV109590 for the adjustable Americano.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108389 and the steam add-ons listed in section 2.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV102824 on each milk module.
Change the milk pipes (every 12 months). 25 m blue 106186, green 106189.
Fit EV111934 for the second outlet.
Record the service (date, interval, kits used). Old 24-month kits may be used for the 36-month interval.

stockNote.title: Old E'line brew kits are gone.
stockNote.text: EV102821 (Service Kit Brewing E'Line) is no longer available: use EV118340. 24-month kits are replaced by 36-month kits (TI-240); 24-month kits in stock can be used for the 36-month interval.

supersessions: E'line brew kit. The new kit adds the top piston 116915 and bottom piston 117268.
Not in the V4.0 manuals. Order module kits instead.

reference.title: Interval rule
reference.text: Under 50,000 cycles a year per group head: 12-month PM in years 1 and 2, 36-month PM in year 3, then repeat. Over 50,000: the same 12, 12, 36 pattern every 50,000 cycles. At least one PM a year is mandatory.

reference.title: Identify the model from the serial
reference.text: First 8 digits of the serial (e'Support, List of machine serial numbers - North America): E'2c 00999400, E'2s 00999100, E'2ms 00998500, E'4s 00998600, E'4ms 00998700, E'4s self-service 00999500, E'4ms self-service 00999600, E'6s 00999700, E'6ms 00999800. There is no E'line Shotmaster: a Shotmaster is an Enigma (Shotmaster runbook).
